blurb: SuFu Cruise offers group transportation services with party buses, limousines, and black car chauffeur services. They provide tours such as Christmas Light Tours and Wine/Brew Tours. Their vehicles accommodate various group sizes and occasions, focusing on safe and enjoyable travel experiences.
extraNote: 50% down payment required to reserve party bus · Extra $60 charged for every 30 minutes past scheduled limo time · Gratuity not included; recommended 15-20% tip for drivers
